source_text:
5.1 Εἰς τὸ
τέλος ὑπὲρ τῆς κληρονο μούσης.
̔Η κληρονομία τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐστιν ἡ φύ σις ἡ
λογική.
pass_a_gloss: Unto the end, concerning the inheriting-one (fem.). The inheritance of-the Christ is the nature the rational.
pass_b_english: “Unto the end, concerning the inheriting one” (Psalm 5 inscription).
The inheritance of Christ is the rational nature.

choices.why: LXX Psalm 5 title: feminine participle of κληρονομέω, not the noun κληρονομία. ὑπέρ in psalm titles is concerning/for, not spatial over.
λογική is rational (λογικὴ φύσις), not English logical.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
